purpose: Teach: 珪/聾/鞍/烏/瑤/螢/禄/鄭

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、半導体の珪素、つまり珪の結晶構造研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — your paper was on semiconductor silicon and crystalline structure research, wasn't it.
lines.style: Measured opening. Professional but warm. Slight upward lilt on the question—genuinely interested in her work. Voice settles into steady, encouraging pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、聾、つまり聴覚障害の医学社会学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper was on deaf studies and the medical sociology of hearing loss.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slight emphasis on the substance of the work itself. Speaking with quiet pride in what she studied. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 馬具の鞍、つまり鞍の歴史的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research covered the history of equestrian saddles — their development and cultural significance.
lines.style: Thoughtful confirmation. Gentle pacing. The affirmation of someone who has read the work carefully. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、生物の烏、つまりカラスの知能研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on corvid intelligence, specifically research on how crows solve problems and learn.
lines.style: Steady, detailed response. Confidence building. She knows this work inside-out and wants him to see that. Not defensive—clarifying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧字「瑤」、つまり瑤宮の地名研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined historical place-name research, including the old character for Yao and the Yao Palace region.
lines.style: Careful, scholarly intonation. Respecting the granular detail of the research. Unhurried. The voice of someone checking understanding, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧字「螢」、つまり蛍の生態研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about firefly ecology, using the older written character. The research looked at their habitats and behavior patterns.
lines.style: Articulate and self-assured. Building momentum slightly. She's warming to the exchange—comfortable now in her own expertise. Clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 江戸時代の禄、つまり俸禄制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in the Edo period, your focus was on the stipend system — the structure of official compensation and rank.
lines.style: Reflective, acknowledging the scope. Slight pause before the core term. Measured delivery. The voice of someone genuinely following the thread of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中国宋代の鄭氏、つまり鄭家の系譜研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my research traced the genealogy of the Zheng family during the Song dynasty in China and their historical influence.
lines.style: Strong, clear conclusion. Finality in the delivery without abruptness. She's earned the right to close on this. Slight settling of tone—satisfying end point.
